name: Mimestream
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Mimestream, build a native Mac Gmail client over standards-based APIs with local cache. The hard boundary is deep gmail api use, native macos polish, sync reliability, and support, plus mail infrastructure, integrations, and client polish.
